description: This Kotlin file defines the UI components for the Android TV Home screen, including the top navigation bar, content sections, and content cards with focus animations using Jetpack Compose.

methods.name: HomeRoot
methods.description: Main composable rendering the entire home screen with top navigation and sections.

methods.name: TopNavBar
methods.description: Composable that renders the horizontal scrollable top navigation bar.

methods.name: NavPill
methods.description: Composable for individual navigation pills with focus animations.

methods.name: SectionRow
methods.description: Displays a section header and the horizontal list of content cards.

methods.name: HorizontalCards
methods.description: Shows a horizontally scrollable row of content cards.

methods.name: ContentCard
methods.description: Displays individual content items with an image, title, and optional progress bar, including focus animations.

methods.name: ProgressBar
methods.description: Progress bar component used within ContentCard to indicate progress.
